biothings.name: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
biothings.definition: An autosomal dominant disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the STK11 gene, characterized by hamartomatous polyps in the gastrointestinal tract, mucocutaneous pigmentation and increased risk of GI and extra-GI malignancies. [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/working-groups/clinical-domain/hereditary-cancer/, Orphanet:2869]
biothings.synonyms: hamartomatous intestinal polyposis, Jeghers-Peutz syndrome, Peutz Jeghers Syndrome, Peutz's syndrome, Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, PJS, polyps and spots syndrome, STK11-related Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
